svg.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Slingshot — magnetism map
svg.desc: Planning-mode mockup with the magnetism danger map on (M): stepped field-strength zones around a magnetar, a pulsar and a ringed gas giant; the predicted path turns into a widening, flickering spread where it crosses the magnetar's field.
